selection_rule: shortest horizon with ROC-AUC >= 0.55 and average precision within 0.01 of the best reliable horizon
limitations: This superseded contract included event-day weather that was not known at prediction time; do not deploy it.
The target records Calendar warranty activity rather than confirmed biological recurrence.
The model cannot attribute outcomes to weather, employees, or treatment quality.
The 2026 reporting period was inspected during earlier experiments and is not a pristine final test set.
Commercial premises have insufficient positive examples for dependable alerts.
